annotations.description: This alert is designed to always fire. With the info-severity route (repeat_interval=24h), operator should see one of these roughly once per day on the ntfy-low topic. If this heartbeat stops arriving, Prometheus evaluation, Alertmanager routing, ntfy delivery, or the phone subscription is broken — investigate in that order.
annotations.summary: Alertmanager dead-man's-switch — if you STOP seeing this, the pipeline is broken
